name: NotesRepository contract
simple: Defines the operations that the domain feature needs without choosing a storage engine.
developer: Declares the NotesRepository app-owned contract; implementations are registered in the composition root.
responsibility: Creates, edits, organizes, and retrieves local study notes, including timestamped notes and embedded images.
notes: Image embeds are implemented: IO platforms save image files under the application documents directory; Web stores image data URLs with browser-local notes.
This does not imply support for arbitrary file attachments.
